diagnosis: The SAML assertion exchange handler validates the SAML response XML signature, but mints a JWT for audience_tenant specified in the client's JSON payload without verifying that the SAML assertion's AudienceRestriction matches audience_tenant. A user authenticated on one tenant can generate API tokens scoped to any target tenant.

POST /sso/saml/exchange-token HTTP/1.1
Host: api.federationgateway.io
Content-Type: application/json
